header.running_head: Severing Ties with the Period of Ignorance to Strengthen Ties with Islaam

blocks.text: The Chapter About How the Sahabah (RA) Relinquished their Carnal Desires

This chapter highlights how the Sahabah (RA) relinquished the instinctive feelings they had for their parents, their children, their brothers, their spouses, their families, their wealth, their businesses and their homes so that they could cling to the love of Allaah, the love of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the love of every Muslim attached to Allaah and Rasulullaah ﷺ. The chapter also highlights how honoured every person who had been attached to Rasulullaah ﷺ in any way

Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) Kills his Father During the Battle of Badr

Hadhrat Ibn Showdhab reports that the father of Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) kept confronting him during the Battle of Badr as Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) continued avoiding him. However, when his father's confrontations became too persistent, Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) killed him. It was then that Allaah revealed the following verse:

blocks.arabic_text: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ يُوَآدُّوْنَ مَنْ حَآدَّ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ وَلَوْ كَانُوْٓا اٰبَآءَهُمْ اَوْ اَبْنَآءَهُمْ اَوْ اِخْوَانَهُمْ اَوْ عَشِيْرَتَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمُ الْاِيْمَانَ وَاَيَّدَهُمْ بِرُوْحٍ مِّنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْا عَنْهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اللّٰهِ اَلَآ اِنَّ حِزْبَ اللّٰهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
